title: fix(ui): disable sidebar pagination while sessions refresh
body:
Related: #150305

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes **Load more sessions** accepting clicks without fetching another page while the selected sidebar list is refreshing, including after another agent's bulk deletion finishes.

## User Impact

Pagination is dimmed and marked busy during the list read, then becomes available again when more sessions remain. The button keeps the default arrow cursor.

## Why This Change Was Made

The canonical roster and filtered sidebar can finish loading independently. Rendering now consumes the sidebar controller's existing loading flag, which also owns the pagination guards. The request, cursor, and agent-selection rules stay with that controller.

## Evidence

The existing bulk-deletion E2E now holds one filtered response while allowing the canonical list to finish. Before the fix, it records an enabled button and a pointer click that sends no pagination request. With the fix, it verifies disabled/busy state, no action during the hold, normal pagination after release, and the original row and filter-recovery assertions.

All 15 browser tests across four related flows and 19 existing pagination tests passed. Core test types, UI types, i18n, formatting, lint, styles, and the remaining selected guards also passed. Independent review through P2 is clean. The screenshots use synthetic local Gateway data.

**Before: the filtered refresh is pending, but the button remains enabled.**

![Before: enabled pagination during a pending filtered refresh](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/20313c2b-c790-4ef2-b800-d3eb6bec33b6)

**After: the matching refresh keeps pagination disabled and busy.**

![After: disabled pagination during a pending filtered refresh](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/117b45d4-0bac-42f4-8060-d65abf224542)
